'''Grade Aurek''' was a classification for [[Egg/Legends|eggs]]. At the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] restaurant [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], Grade Aurek [[Gartro]] eggs were used in the recipes for [[Gartro egg omelet]]s and Garto egg salad [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwiches]].<ref name="Dining">''{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}''</ref>
